marketLayer.title: US Big Tech AI Infrastructure Capex
marketLayer.fact: Major US technology companies announced increased capital expenditure forecasts specifically allocated toward AI hardware, data center expansion, and custom chip developments.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained high infrastructure spending underpins revenue visibility for upstream semiconductor manufacturers and memory providers, though it places short-term pressure on hyperscaler margin profiles.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of commercial enterprise AI adoption and tangible ROI realization across software end-markets.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Tech Stocks & Southbound Inflows
marketLayer.fact: Southbound Stock Connect registered robust net daily buying, with capital concentrating in major Hong Kong-listed internet platforms and high-dividend state-owned enterprises.
marketLayer.inference: Persistent liquidity support from mainland funds provides a structural buffer for the Hang Seng Index against broader global macro volatility and foreign capital rebalancing.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Shift in mainland investor sentiment and potential regulatory policy adjustments affecting cross-border flows.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Interest Rate Trajectory
marketLayer.fact: Recent US macro indicators revealed resilient labor market conditions and sticky core inflation metrics, keeping 10-year Treasury yields elevated.
marketLayer.inference: Prolonged high interest rates maintain valuation headwinds for long-duration growth assets across both US equity indices and Hong Kong growth sectors.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Upcoming US PCE inflation data releases and tone shifts in Federal Reserve FOMC communications.

marketLayer.title: China New Energy Vehicles (NEV) Price Competition
marketLayer.fact: Hong Kong-listed domestic EV makers introduced renewed summer pricing promotions and promotional financing incentives to defend domestic market share.
marketLayer.inference: Margin compression risks remain acute across the mid-to-entry EV segments, encouraging accelerated market consolidation and prioritizing companies with strong supply chain integration.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolution of overseas trade policies/tariffs and domestic consumer expenditure recovery rates in China.
